definition: an actor in a crowd who never speaks
description: On a film set on a rainy cobbled street, a young woman in a brown old-fashioned coat and hat with a paper tag pinned to it stands silently in a line of people in similar period coats and hats behind a rope. A brown hat falls through the air and lands on the wet stones. The view moves closer to her face as she looks down and closes her eyes. Further back, under a big tarpaulin and bright film lights, two actors in suits stand with a crew member holding an umbrella next to a rail of costumes.

en.question: What is the woman in front doing?

de.answer: Sie steht in einer Reihe von Statisten.

fr.answer: Elle se tient dans une file de figurants.
